title: File:Lahore Metro 05.jpg
desc:
So i first time travelled through Orange Line Metro Train & had a Birdseye view of Lahore City! 
Facts
1. Orange Line is an automated rapid transit system in Lahore, Pakistan, maximum speed of the trains is 80 km/h (50 mph).
2. The line is Pakistan's first metro train since the Karachi Circular Rail
